material_updates.topic: HUST Chinese Government Scholarship 2027 route eligibility for Kazakhstan English MBBS
material_updates.finding: Official HUST 2027 CSC information specifies Type A Bilateral Program accepts undergraduate candidates, with no application fee and application through home-country dispatching authorities rather than direct HUST/CSC. Type B Chinese University Program is postgraduate-only. Type B Silk Road program excludes Kazakhstan (10 listed countries) and offers only Chinese-taught Architecture and Software Engineering at bachelor level. The Type B ¥800 fee is distinct from Type A no-fee route. English MBBS eligibility and full coverage through Kazakhstan Type A remain unconfirmed.
